query: What signals suggest a travel expense will be declined?

per_column.name: expense_category
per_column.rationale: Category of expense (travel vs hardware etc.) is knowable at submission and plausibly correlates with decline likelihood; a legitimate external predictor.

per_column.name: ci_asset_type
per_column.rationale: Type of configuration item/asset is an antecedent attribute independent of the outcome and could carry signal about approval/decline patterns.

per_column.name: is_miscellaneous_ci
per_column.rationale: Flag for miscellaneous/unclassified CI is knowable up front; ambiguous or miscategorized items may be more likely to be declined. Weak but legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: entry_origin
per_column.rationale: How the entry originated (manual vs automated vs travel report) is a pre-outcome process attribute that can plausibly relate to decline rates.

per_column.name: has_source_id
per_column.rationale: Presence of a source_id reflects provenance/completeness at intake; can carry weak predictive signal and is not derived from the outcome.

per_column.name: has_processed_date
per_column.rationale: Whether a processed_date exists is populated when the expense is processed/resolved. Its presence is a consequence of the state transition, so it leaks the outcome rather than predicting it.

per_column.name: expense_action_type
per_column.rationale: Action/workflow type (registration, procurement, etc.) is an antecedent categorical attribute that may correlate with decline; legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: department_group
per_column.rationale: Grouped department is a stable submitter attribute knowable before the decision and plausibly linked to decline rates; a reasonable external predictor.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are legitimate antecedent features (expense/CI/action categories, entry origin, department group) that are external to state_declined and could carry weak-to-moderate signal. However several are largely re-derivations of existing original columns (category, ci, department, source_id) rather than genuinely new information, limiting marginal predictive leverage. has_processed_date is a leakage feature because processed_date is set as part of resolving the item, correlating with the outcome mechanically. As a set the utility is modest: real but low-to-moderate, and diminished by redundancy with existing columns and one leaking flag.
